 公平值計量                           FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENT
 公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者                 Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an
 之間於有序交易中出售資產所收取                 asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
 或轉讓負債所支付的價格，不管該                 between market participants at the measurement date,
 價格是否可直接觀察得到或使用另                 regardless of whether that price is directly observable or
 一估值技巧而估計。於估計資產或                 estimated using another valuation technique. In estimating
 負債的公平值時，倘市場參與者於                 the fair value of an asset or a liability, the Group takes into
 計量當日為資產或負債定價時將會                 account the characteristics of the asset or liability if market
 考慮的資產或負債的特點時，則本                 participants would take those characteristics into account
 集團會考慮該等特點。                      when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement date.

 非金融資產公平值之計量則參考市                 A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
 場參與者可從使用該資產得到之最                 account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
 高及最佳效用，或把該資產售予另                 benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
 一可從使用該資產得到最高及最佳                 selling it to another market participant that would use the
 效用之市場參與者所產生之經濟效                 asset in its highest and best use.
 益。

 此 外，就 財 務 報 告 而 言，公 平 值 計       In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
 量乃根據公平值計量輸入數據的可                 measurements are categorised into Level 1, 2 or 3 based
 觀察程度及公平值計量輸入數據的                 on the degree to which the inputs to the fair value
 整體重要性而劃分為第一級、第二                 measurements are observable and the significance of the
 級或第三級，詳述如下：                     inputs to the fair value measurement in its entirety, which
                                 are described as follows:

 •   第一級輸入數據為該實體可於               •    Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active
     計量當日自相同資產或負債的                    markets for identical assets or liabilities that the entity
     活 躍 市 場 取 得 的 報 價（未 經 調          can access at the measurement date;
     整）；

 •   第二級輸入數據為第一級內所               •    Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
     載報價以外就資產或負債可直                    included within Level 1, that are observable for the
     接或間接觀察的輸入數據；及                    asset or liability, either directly or indirectly; and

 •   第三級輸入數據為就資產或負               •    Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or
     債而無法觀察的輸入數據。                     liability.

  的 信 貸 虧 損 計 提 撥 備（12 個 月 預 期         next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures
  信 貸 虧 損）。就 自 初 次 確 認 起 大 幅           for which there has been a significant increase in credit risk
  增加的信貸風險而言，不論發生違                      since initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit

  幅 增 加。進 行 評 估 時，本 集 團 比 較            since initial recognition. When making the assessment,

  料，包括歷史及前瞻性資料。                        supportable information that is available without undue
                                       cost or effort, including historical and forward-looking
                                       information.

  視為已違約。                               credit enhancements held by the Group.

  實際利率法                               Effective interest method
  實際利率法是計算金融負債攤銷成                     The effective interest method is a method of calculating the
  本及於相關期間分配利息支出的方                     amortised cost of a financial liability and of allocating interest

  利率組成部分之已付或已收之所有                     integral part of the effective interest rate, transaction costs
  費用，交易成本及其他溢價或折讓）                    and other premiums or discounts) through the expected
  至初次確認時之賬面淨值之利率。                     life of the financial liability, or, where appropriate, a shorter
                                      period, to the net carrying amount on initial recognition.

  利息開支乃按實際利率基準確認。                     Interest expense is recognised on an effective interest basis.

  附註：                                   Notes:

  (a)   本集團的估值程序                        (a)      Valuation processes of the Group

        本集團按公平值對其投資物業進行計量。本                      The Group measures its investment properties at fair value. The fair value of the
        集團投資物業於二零二四年十二月三十一                       Group’s investment properties as at 31 December 2024 has been determined
        日的公平值是根據仲量聯行企業評估及諮                       on the basis of valuation carried out by Jones Lang LaSalle Corporate Appraisal
        詢有限公司及萊坊有限責任合夥（均為獨立                      and Advisory Limited and Knight Frank LLP, both are independent and
        及專業合資格估值師）進行的估值而釐定。                      professionally qualified valuers.

        管理層與估值師每六個月最少對估值程序                       Discussions of valuation processes and results are held between management
        及結果進行一次討論，與本集團之中期及年                      and valuers at least once every six months, in line with the timing of Group’s
        度報告時間一致。                                 interim and annual reporting.

  (b)   估值技術                            (b)      Valuation techniques

        估值採用之估值方法包括已落成物業所用                       The valuation methodologies adopted in valuations include income approach
        的收益法及╱或直接比較法，在建物業所用                      and/or direct comparison method for completed properties and residual
        的剩餘法、直接比較法及╱或成本法，以及                      method, direct comparison method and/or cost method for the properties
        使用權資產所用之收益法。                             under construction and income approach for the right-of-use assets.

        收益法通過計算標的物業當前租約的租金                       The income approach operates by taking into account the rental income of the
        收入，並計算出租及空置部分的潛在租金收                      subject property derived from the existing tenancies with due allowance for the
        入，然後按合適的資本化率將其資本化為價                      potential reversionary income of the tenanted and vacant portions, which are
        值。                                       then capitalised at an appropriate capitalisation rate.

        直接比較法涉及分析近期巿場上同類型物                       The direct comparison method involves the analysis of recent market evidence
        業的案例並與該等估值物業進行比較。選取                      of similar properties and comparing them with the subject property under
        面積大小、屬性及位置類近的可資比較物業                      valuation. Comparable properties with similar size, characteristics and locations
        進行分析，並仔細權衡各自的優劣之處，從                      are analysed, and carefully weighed against all respective advantage and
        而達至公允的評估價值。                              disadvantages in order to arrive at a fair comparison of value.

        剩餘法考慮總發展價值並扣除尚未發生的建                      The residual method takes into account the residual value of the gross
        築成本、開支以及發展利潤後的剩餘價值。                      development value (“GDV”) after deduction of the outstanding construction
        剩餘法首先計算假設建議發展項目於估值                       costs and expenses as well as profit element. It involves firstly the assessment
        日已落成的合計總發展價值。建議發展項目                      of the aggregate GDV of the proposed development, as if completed, as at
        的估計成本包括建築成本、市場推廣支出、                      the valuation date. Estimated costs of the proposed development include
        專業費用、財務費用以及相關成本，另加發                      construction costs, marketing expense, professional fee, finance charges and
        展商的風險及利潤撥備。尚未發生的開發成                      associated costs, plus an allowance for the developer’s risk and profit. The
        本將自總發展價值中扣除，並得出標的物業                      outstanding development costs are then deducted from the GDV and the
        的剩餘價值。                                   resultant figure is the residual value of the subject property.

        成本法採用總重置成本以得出標的物業於                       The cost approach is a method of using gross replacement costs to arrive at
        估值日現狀的價值。成本法需要估算該土地                      the value of the subject property in its existing state as at the valuation date.
        現值，另加該土地上改造工程的重置成本估                      The cost approach requires estimates of the current value of the land plus the
        算。改造工程重置成本包括建築工程成本、                      estimated replacement cost of the land improvement works. The replacement
        地盤工程成本、財務費用及工程相關成本。                      cost of the improvement works includes the cost of the building work, site
                                                 works, finance charges and relevant associated costs.

        於估計物業公平值時，物業的最高及最佳用                      In estimating the fair value of the properties, the highest and best use of the
        途為其現時用途。                                 properties is their current use.

       的供應商提供較相關發票付款到期日為早                                       provide the willing suppliers early payment terms, compared with the related
